upstream.archive_method: git archive --format=tar.gz at exact commit, including original LICENSE/tests, excluding history and task solutions

original_contribution: Integrated Database.merge_preserving_keys and CLI: graph-wide deterministic fresh-key allocation, FK rewriting, read-only WAL-aware source snapshots, typed logical fingerprints, persisted maps/provenance, all-source atomicity and caller savepoint behavior.

sources.use: Source, existing transaction/FK APIs and missing proposed merge feature
Public demand for merging independent database contents and PK collisions
Overlapping generic merge proposal; source patch inspected during research
Read-transaction snapshot isolation and WAL semantics
Constraint deferral and transaction-related pragma behavior
Already shipped atomic/savepoint and compound FK behavior must not be claimed as new

public_solution_overlap.prior_art: Open PR724 loops over source tables and calls insert_all with preserve/replace/ignore key behavior. It does not provide graph key remapping, WAL snapshot identity, persistent key maps or all-source atomicity. This task is an explicit extension beyond that public proposal, not an undisclosed reproduction.
public_solution_overlap.audit_limit: Pinned source and relevant public PRs inspected; no exhaustive absence claim across historical forks.

contract_scope.supported: Existing compatible tables, rowid-alias INTEGER PKs, distinct non-PK single-column integer/null FKs to selected parent PKs; self-links/cycles, negative IDs, AUTOINCREMENT high-water marks, ordinary destination constraints/triggers.
contract_scope.excluded: Composite/shared-primary keys, multi-FK child fields, generated/virtual/WITHOUT ROWID layouts, selected source triggers, schema reconciliation, concurrent destination writers, cross-file simultaneous snapshots.

horizon.hypothesis: Maintaining identity and referential integrity across snapshot loading, typed fingerprinting, graph-wide allocation, deferred insertion, trigger outcomes, metadata commit, retries and caller transactions may require sustained coordinated engineering. Code/patch size is not a horizon measurement.

construction.harbor_validation: Current accepted Harbor oracle/nop results and exact revision bindings are maintained in ../../research/shortlist.json; local construction runs below remain historical evidence.
